content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use, territory or exclusivity restraint binding Northwind. Section 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and operate in any field or territory, and confirms we have made no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment — this exceeds the preferred playbook position.

Competition-related restraints in the document run against Brightline (12.4 no directly competing analytics service during the term; 24 no assignment to a Customer competitor) and benefit us, so they are not flagged. Section 13.4's anti-reverse-engineering and anti-misuse limits are ordinary licence protections with law and security-testing carve-outs, not competitive restrictions.
